decision_cruda.rationale: The radio and CMMS agree that LH-06 is down at TJ-C512-01 with a hydraulic fault. OT-5100 gives 1 / 1.5 / 2 h, repaired on site, so no confirmation is needed under CONFIRM-01. Stope C512-01 has 251 - 107 = 144 t of broken ore left. LH-06 (LH514, 220 m) mucks about 35.6 t/h, so it needs about 4 h to clear it. Loading time left is about 6.5 h (10:00-11:00 plus 11:30-17:00). Even if the repair takes the full 2 h, about 5 h remain, so the stope is still emptied and the downtime costs no ounces. LH-10 (LH410) is in preventive maintenance until 11:00, and its best case is about 25 t/h from 11:30. Sending it would add nothing when LH-06 is back, and the layer decides who keeps the stope on return (RETURN-01). Taking a Norte loader would need about 0.7 h of travel to the Central portal. It would also remove production from a mine that is truck-limited but whose loaders still have ore to muck, for no gain. The only reserves are stopped-stope reserves, and no stope is stopped, so none can be activated (RESERVE-01). Best action is to keep everything as is, an expected gain of about 0 oz versus doing nothing.
